locality: Malpa village, Kali valley
scenario_notes: Rockfall over several days (16-21 Aug) buried a village on the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra route; about 60 of the dead were pilgrims. Sources disagree on deaths (221 Wikipedia, 239 EM-DAT, 250 Wikipedia Cloudburst).

locality: Badrinath shrine area, Alaknanda valley
scenario_notes: Cloudburst-triggered landslides swept 3 vehicles into the Alaknanda; 28 injured and about 5,000 pilgrims stranded on the highway.

locality: Nachni area near Munsiyari
scenario_notes: Landslide after a cloudburst. EM-DAT records 45 deaths with a start date of 8 Aug.

locality: Balta and one other village
scenario_notes: Cloudburst submerged two villages; Balta was almost entirely lost. EM-DAT groups this into a wider Almora/Nainital flood (200 deaths).

locality: Assi Ganga valley hydel project; Bhagirathi near Gangotri
scenario_notes: Labourers at a hydel project site went missing; low-lying areas evacuated to higher ground; three small hydel projects shut down.

locality: Ukhimath
scenario_notes: Cloudburst. Wikipedia Cloudburst article dates it 14 Sep 2013; EM-DAT 2012-0354 (16 Sep 2012, 45 deaths) matches the place, so 2012 is used here - verify.

locality: Kedarnath, Rambara, Gaurikund, Sonprayag (state-wide)
responders: NDRF 13 teams (422 personnel); ITBP ~2,000 (33,009 rescued in 15 days); Army; IAF; Navy MARCOS; 83 aircraft by 23 Jun
scenario_notes: Worst case reference. Settlements obliterated; ~84,000 stranded for days; Army split operations into 4 axes; an IAF Mi-17 crashed during rescue (20 killed incl. 9 NDRF, 6 ITBP).

locality: Bastadi, Naulanda, Charma and Patharkot villages, Singhali area
responders: Rescue teams with life detectors and victim locating devices; dog squads; 2 JCBs
scenario_notes: Early-hours cloudburst, over 100 mm in two hours over about 50 sq km; houses in 7+ villages buried. Mud and slush covered 5 km from Bastadi to Charmagarh. 240 people were in relief camps on day 4. Early reports ranged 12-30 dead because some counted Chamoli too. Deaths here are the ToI village count of 4 Jul (Bastadi 12, Naulanda 3, Charma 1, Patharkot 1); 8 still missing at Bastadi. Point is OSM 'Bastari'.

locality: Mangti Nala army camp and Malpa, Kailash Mansarovar Yatra route, Dharchula
responders: At Mangti: SDRF 30, SSB 15, Army 14, ITBP 2. At Malpa: SSB 26, Army 10. NDRF; helicopters
scenario_notes: Two night cloudbursts (13-14 Aug) caused landslips; one buried an army camp at Mangti Nala (2 JCOs, 5 jawans and 7 porters feared swept away). Official and local tolls disagree: state said 1 dead / 8 missing at Mangti, locals 14 at Mangti and 14 at Malpa. The CM's helicopter could not land in the rain. Point is OSM 'Mangti'.

locality: Arakot, Makudi, Molda, Tikochi, Sanel and Nakota, Mori tehsil
rescued_or_evacuated: 10 injured rescued by SDRF at Sanel
responders: ITBP; NDRF; SDRF; police; health teams; IAF helicopters
scenario_notes: Cloudburst around 4 am on a Sunday hit several villages in the upper Tons valley (Arakot worst). The toll grew from 2 dead / 23 missing on day 1 to 15+ dead / 20 missing by 29 Aug. IAF flew relief from Jolly Grant and airlifted the injured to Dehradun. Two helicopters crashed in the area within four days, so air operations were suspended.

locality: Tanga and Gaila Pattharkot villages, Bangapani subdivision near Munsiyari
responders: SDRF 10; revenue police 20; 2 medical teams on standby; locals digging
scenario_notes: Cloudburst around 3:40 am. A house in Gaila caved in on a family of three; in Tanga one survivor said 11 others were washed away by a swollen rivulet. 6 injured. The toll rose 3 -> 5 -> 10 over three days as bodies were dug out of rubble.

locality: Raini village, Rishiganga and Tapovan hydro sites
responders: NDRF 3 teams flown by C-130J; ITBP tunnel rescue
scenario_notes: Rock-ice avalanche caused a flash flood; ~140 of the dead and missing were hydro-project workers, some trapped in tunnels; a bridge serving 13 villages was washed away; dams downstream drained. Wikipedia infobox shows 18 Feb, its text and EM-DAT say 7 Feb.

locality: Chhara village, Khairna, Mukteshwar (Kumaon-wide)
responders: NDRF 17 teams; SDRF 7 teams; PAC 15 companies; 5,000+ police
scenario_notes: Record October rain; house collapses and landslides; Nainital cut off by road. About 35 deaths in Nainital district, the rest in Champawat, Almora, Pithoragarh, Udham Singh Nagar, Bageshwar. Death toll reports range 52-79.

locality: Sarkhet village, Raipur block; also Maldevta, Bhutsi, Thatyud and other villages
rescued_or_evacuated: All stranded villagers rescued (no count given)
scenario_notes: Cloudburst at 2:45 am per locals; mud entered homes in over a dozen villages. No loss of life was reported. Residents were moved to schools and panchayat buildings; some sheltered in a nearby resort. Useful as a low-severity, many-requests scenario close to the city.

locality: Daat Puliya near Gaurikund, Kedarnath Yatra route
responders: NDRF + SDRF ~100 personnel; DDRF; police; water police; fire service
scenario_notes: Night-time landslide and flash flood swept three roadside shops into the Mandakini with ~23 people inside; falling boulders and rain stopped the search repeatedly. Initially 3 dead / 20 missing; 10 dead / 13 missing by 28 Aug.
sources: Down To Earth (Gaurikund landslide);Hindustan Times 2023-08-05;Times of India 2023-08-28

locality: Chirbasa sliding zone near the helipad, Kedarnath foot route above Gaurikund
scenario_notes: Landslide on the trek route killed 3 pilgrims and injured 5. Cited as background in a 2026 report, which also lists 2-6 deaths a year on this route in 2017-2024. Point is an estimate a little above Gaurikund, not a mapped site.

locality: Kedarnath trek route: Lincholi, Bhimbali, Jungle Chatti, Rambara, Ghorapadav
responders: SDRF; NDRF; police; IAF Chinook and Mi-17
scenario_notes: Evening cloudburst with ~15,000 pilgrims on the route; trek washed away at several points; people walked to Sonprayag or were airlifted from Lincholi helipad; operation ran 5+ days.

locality: Dharali village, Kheer Ganga, Gangotri route
responders: Army Ibex brigade; NDRF 4 teams; ITBP 3 teams; SDRF; IAF on standby
scenario_notes: Debris flow tore through a village on the Gangotri pilgrim route, destroying houses and hotels; bad weather grounded helicopters.

locality: Tharali town, Sagwara and Chepdo villages
responders: SDRF; police; district administration; ITBP 8th Bn platoon from Gauchar
scenario_notes: Late-night cloudburst; debris buried homes, shops, the tehsil complex and the SDM's residence. Tharali-Gwaldam and Tharali-Sagwara roads closed. Reports disagree on missing (one elderly man at Chepdo; two at Sagwara, one later found dead).

locality: Sahastradhara, Maldevta, Tapkeshwar, Paundha
rescued_or_evacuated: 900+ rescued; 200-500 students from a waterlogged campus
responders: SDRF; NDRF; police; PWD with JCBs
scenario_notes: Overnight cloudburst in the state capital; shops, cars and a road stretch washed away; 500+ stranded; a tractor-trolley with 10-12 people trapped in the Asan river. Toll reports range 13-18.

locality: Kuntari Lagafali and Dhurma villages, Nandanagar
rescued_or_evacuated: 5 rescued alive (4 Kuntari Lagafali, 1 Dhurma); one man after ~16 h under debris
responders: SDRF; NDRF; locals; serious injured airlifted to AIIMS Rishikesh
scenario_notes: Night cloudburst buried houses. 12-20 injured. Counts changed a lot between outlets and days. Good source for 'trapped under debris, alive' requests: a woman was pulled out with local help and a man after about 16 hours. Point is OSM 'Dhurma'.

locality: Munkatiya, between Sonprayag and Gaurikund, Kedarnath Yatra route
scenario_notes: Late-night landslide blocked the main road with pilgrims stranded in dark, rain and falling debris. No casualties reported. Mass-stranding scenario rather than trapped victims. The article (20 May 2026) says 'Tuesday late night' (19 May) but also mentions 9 May. Point is midway between Sonprayag and Gaurikund.
